items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: I saw Bennie Pollack's band with the original band

ctx.x: I played through school with a local band like everybody does. But I was very, very fortunate during my high school days from 1928 on, in my home town -- in the state of Maine, all the colleges had big bands in those days, and the old Archer Pier which is a beach near my home, with the Shrimlin Brothers -- they played every name band, and I had the opportunity from age 14 thru 18 when I got through high school to go and hear all these bands. When I was only 14 or 15 years old, I heard McKinney's Cotton Pickers in…
But I had the chance to watch these people, and Don Redman was leading the band then, and I saw Bennie Pollack's band with the original band with Ray Bauduc on drums at the
Pier -- I had the chance to watch these people in action.
